suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare infection complication. Require documented Brucella infection, a prosthetic cardiac valve, and separately confirmed Brucella prosthetic-valve infective endocarditis. Systematic review is specific to prosthetic-valve Brucella endocarditis and rare reported cases; do not generalize to native-valve disease or uncomplicated brucellosis. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
